about.title: Hello
about.text: I'm a first-year Master's student in Marketing and Innovation Strategy at IAE Saint-Étienne, on a double degree with ENCG Settat, and I focus on strategic and digital marketing. Content creation is my passion, and I'm comfortable on both sides: I analyze the data, then turn it into images, videos and ideas. A former active member of student clubs and AIESEC, I moved to France in 2026 for my Master's.

projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: Three projects, three ways of working: luxury co-branding, staged operational marketing and entrepreneurship.

porsche-hermes.title: Porsche × Hermès “911 Sellier”
porsche-hermes.context: “Branding: strategy and performance” module (L. Ambroise), Master's Year 1 in Marketing and Innovation Strategy, IAE Saint-Étienne, October 2026. Duo project with Ichrak Zerqaoui.
porsche-hermes.concept: A co-development between Porsche and Hermès. The 911 Sellier is a series of 24 classic Porsche 911s (G-series, 1974-1989) restored by Porsche Classic in Stuttgart and upholstered by Hermès saddlers, each delivered with a limited-edition Kelly bag. Signature line: “For those who miss the 911”.
steps: Diagnosis of both brands (Kapferer identity prisms)
Fit assessment on Deng & Messinger's 6 dimensions
Competitive analysis: Louis Vuitton × Singer, Berluti, Aimé Leon Dore × Porsche, a Chiron upholstered by Hermès
porsche-hermes.role: Co-author of the summary report and the presentation.
porsche-hermes.output: A 4-page summary report and a presentation.

sephora.tagline: “Sephora Secret”: a detective investigation into the impact of chatbots.
sephora.context: Analysis of Sephora's 4Ps and of the impact of chatbots on the customer experience.
sephora.concept: A presentation staged as a detective investigation, “Sephora Secret”, to reveal the impact of chatbots on Sephora's customer experience, opened by an intro video I made.
sephora.role: Made the intro video for the presentation.
